text: Independent Windows check of PR #624 at 7ba15f6: using CPython 3.12 on native Windows, the focused signing-key suite produced 7 passes and 1 failure. The new canonical base64url, malformed-character, padding, DID, and signature checks passed. The remaining failure occurs before exercising PR #624 logic because tests/unit/test_mcp_signing.py imports src/store.py, whose unconditional fcntl import is unavailable on Windows. Scope: this supports the signing-key validation change while identifying a Windows-only test portability boundary; it is not evidence of a signing regression. PR: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/624
